name: streamhold
description: 占位保活反代：让冷启动上游的图片请求在急性子代理（GitHub camo 等）面前永不超时

scripts.build: SCRIPTC_TARGET=x86_64-linux-musl scriptc build --optimization speed --strip --exceptions rare streamhold.ts -o streamhold
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && scp streamhold "${DEPLOY_TARGET:?请在环境或 .env 设置 DEPLOY_TARGET，如 root@<server>:/root/app/streamhold/streamhold-native}"
